# Wahyu Andika Putra - Software Engineer & Cybersecurity Specialist

Wahyu Andika Putra is a Software Engineer and Cybersecurity Specialist (Web2 / Web3) based in Wonosobo, Central Java, Indonesia.

## Core Services
- **Jasa Pembuatan Website & Aplikasi Full-Stack:** Custom landing pages, dashboards, and full-stack applications using Astro, Next.js, and other modern stacks.
- **Jasa Pembuatan Aplikasi Android & Upload Play Store:** End-to-end Android application development and publishing to Google Play Store.
- **Security Hardening & Audit Defensif:** Threat modeling, secure coding reviews, and infrastructure hardening.
- **Smart Contract & Protokol Web3:** Smart contract security audits and DeFi protocol risk reviews.
